chunks.ar: في قرية صغيرة، كان هناك نجار يعمل قرب الغابة.
chunks.en_old: In a small village, a carpenter worked near the forest.
chunks.en_new: In a small village, a carpenter worked near the forest.

chunks.ar: كل صباح، يجلس أمام بيته ويصنع أبوابًا وطاولات من الخشب.
chunks.en_old: Every morning he sat outside his house making doors and tables from wood.
chunks.en_new: Every morning he sat outside his house making doors and tables from wood.

chunks.ar: وكان قرد فضولي يراقبه من فوق شجرة قريبة.
chunks.en_old: A curious monkey watched him from a nearby tree.
chunks.en_new: A curious monkey watched him from a nearby tree.

chunks.ar: ذات يوم، وضع النجار قطعة خشب كبيرة على الأرض.
chunks.en_old: One day, the carpenter placed a large log on the ground.
chunks.en_new: One day, the carpenter placed a large log on the ground.

chunks.ar: أراد أن يقسمها إلى نصفين، فاستخدم منشارًا حتى فتح شقًّا في وسطها.
chunks.en_old: He wanted to split it in two, so he used a saw to make a gap in its middle.
chunks.en_new: He wanted to split it in two, so he used a saw to make a gap in its middle.

chunks.ar: ثم وضع قطعة صغيرة من الخشب داخل الشق.
chunks.en_old: Then he put a small piece of wood inside the gap.
chunks.en_new: Then he put a small piece of wood inside the gap.

chunks.ar: كانت القطعة الصغيرة تُبقي النصفين متباعدين، حتى يستطيع النجار متابعة عمله بسهولة.
chunks.en_old: The small piece kept the two halves apart so the carpenter could continue his work easily.
chunks.en_new: The small piece kept the two halves apart so the carpenter could continue his work easily.

chunks.ar: وبعد وقت قصير، شعر النجار بالتعب.
chunks.en_old: After a while, he grew tired.
chunks.en_new: After a while, he grew tired.

chunks.ar: ترك أدواته وذهب إلى البيت ليأكل ويستريح.
chunks.en_old: He left his tools and went inside to eat and rest.
chunks.en_new: He left his tools and went inside to eat and rest.

chunks.ar: نزل القرد من الشجرة، واقترب من الخشب.
chunks.en_old: The monkey climbed down from the tree and approached the log.
chunks.en_new: The monkey climbed down from the tree and approached the log.

chunks.ar: قال في نفسه: «رأيت النجار يعمل طوال الصباح.
chunks.en_old: “I have watched the carpenter all morning,” he thought.
chunks.en_new: “I have watched the carpenter all morning,” he thought.

chunks.ar: يبدو هذا العمل سهلًا، ويمكنني أن أفعل مثله!»
chunks.en_old: “This work looks easy. I can do it too!”
chunks.en_new: “This work looks easy. I can do it too!”

chunks.ar: ثم جلس على القطعة الكبيرة.
chunks.en_old: Then he sat on the large piece of wood.
chunks.en_new: Then he sat on the large piece of wood.

chunks.ar: نظر القرد إلى القطعة الصغيرة داخل الشق، ولم يفهم لماذا وضعها النجار هناك.
chunks.en_old: The monkey looked at the small piece in the gap and did not understand why the carpenter had put it there.
chunks.en_new: The monkey looked at the small piece in the gap and did not understand why the carpenter had put it there.

chunks.ar: مدّ يده وأمسك بها، ثم أخذ يسحبها بكل قوته.
chunks.en_old: He reached out and pulled it with all his strength.
chunks.en_new: He reached out, took hold of it, and began pulling it with all his strength.

chunks.ar: تحركت القطعة قليلًا، فزاد القرد سحبه.
chunks.en_old: It moved a little, so he pulled harder.
chunks.en_new: It moved a little, so he pulled harder.

chunks.ar: وفجأة خرجت القطعة الصغيرة من مكانها، وأغلق الخشب على ذيل القرد!
chunks.en_old: Suddenly, the small piece came out, and the log closed around the monkey’s tail!
chunks.en_new: Suddenly, the small piece came out, and the log closed around the monkey’s tail!

chunks.ar: صرخ القرد وحاول أن يقفز، لكنه لم يستطع.
chunks.en_old: The monkey cried out and tried to jump away, but he could not.
chunks.en_new: The monkey cried out and tried to jump away, but he could not.

chunks.ar: كان ذيله عالقًا، وكلما تحرك شعر بألم أكبر.
chunks.en_old: His tail was trapped, and every movement hurt more.
chunks.en_new: His tail was trapped, and every movement hurt more.

chunks.ar: سمع النجار الصراخ، فعاد مسرعًا.
chunks.en_old: The carpenter heard the cries and hurried back.
chunks.en_new: The carpenter heard the cries and hurried back.

chunks.ar: رأى القرد فوق الخشب، وفهم ما حدث.
chunks.en_old: He saw the monkey on the log and understood what had happened.
chunks.en_new: He saw the monkey on the log and understood what had happened.

chunks.ar: استخدم أداة ليفتح الشق من جديد، ثم أخرج ذيل القرد بحذر، وابتعد عنه حتى يهدأ.
chunks.en_old: He used a tool to open the gap again, carefully freed the monkey’s tail, and stepped back to let him calm down.
chunks.en_new: He used a tool to open the gap again, carefully freed the monkey’s tail, and stepped back to let him calm down.

chunks.ar: قفز القرد إلى الشجرة، وجلس بين الأغصان وهو يتألم.
chunks.en_old: The monkey leaped into the tree and sat among the branches, still hurting.
chunks.en_new: The monkey leaped into the tree and sat among the branches, still hurting.

chunks.ar: نظر إلى النجار الذي عاد إلى عمله، لكنه هذه المرة لم يحاول تقليده.
chunks.en_old: He watched the carpenter return to his work, but this time he did not try to imitate him.
chunks.en_new: He watched the carpenter return to his work, but this time he did not try to imitate him.

chunks.ar: بقي يراقب من بعيد، دون أن يلمس الأدوات.
chunks.en_old: He stayed at a distance and did not touch the tools.
chunks.en_new: He stayed at a distance and did not touch the tools.
